source_text: Extendisti dexteram tuam, et devoravit eos terra. Terra quae absorbet hostes — iudicium Dei; aliquando inferorum profundum. Ecclesia extendit manus in cruce Christi.
pass_a_gloss: You-stretched-out right-hand your, and devoured them earth. Earth which swallows enemies — judgment of-God; sometimes of-underworld depth. Church stretches hands on cross of-Christ.
pass_b_english: [[You stretched out your right hand, and the earth swallowed them >> Bible:Exodus 15:12]]. The earth that swallows foes is God’s judgment — sometimes the deep itself. The church learns to stretch out hands in the shape of Christ’s cross.
